name: General Mills - Belvidere IL Distribution Center

fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (42.26391,-88.844267, APPROXIMATE) pointed at a residential neighborhood in central Belvidere - wrong. Web research (WIFR, Belvidere Chamber, Growth Dimensions) identified the actual DC at 1210 Irene Rd, on 111 acres at the realigned Irene Rd / US-20 intersection. Locked center 42.2440,-88.8975 by satellite - a single ~1.3M sq ft warehouse confirmed by 2025-08 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access road leaves US-20 at a signalized intersection and curves NE into the property at its NW corner. Property is a controlled industrial site; satellite imagery is mid-construction (bare-dirt yard) so a gate structure is not yet visible, but a new state-of-the-art automated DC of this scale is treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identifiable. Satellite is construction-era; 2025-08 Street View covers the public road only and does not extend onto the private driveway, so a booth could exist but none seen. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth - this is a brand-new highly automated facility, consistent with kiosk/app check-in. Low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The access road from US-20 to the building is long (curving ~250m+ from the public-road intersection), with ample room to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide curved entry apron and large undeveloped paved/graded width near the NW corner give clear room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank runs the full NE-facing wall; z18 imagery shows roughly 50-70 dock positions with many trailers backed in. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of perpendicular-parked trailers sits in the NE-side yard apart from the active dock face - a drop/parking row of roughly 15-25 stalls. Banded 10-25; flagged.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors are on a single building face (NE side); the SW face is blank wall. Ship and receive run from one dock cluster - not separate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer parking row present in the NE yard separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site surrounded by farmland on the SW industrial fringe of Belvidere - Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the parallel cleared strip NE of the building is a utility/road corridor, not rail.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~113 acres, consistent with the reported 111-acre parcel.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single distribution building; smaller structures NW and SW are separate, unrelated properties.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Mid-construction imagery; ~40-50 trailers visible at docks and in the drop row. Approximate - flagged.
